### Replacing the Shadows
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/replacing-the-shadows
Passage: Hebrews 8:1-2
Points:
- Jesus did not come merely to join the Levitical priesthood, but to bring that entire system to completion.
- His finished work directs our attention solely to Him as our ultimate sacrifice and heavenly Priest.
- The earthly tabernacle, offerings, and priests were only anticipatory shadows pointing forward.
- Just as seeing a real parent provides far greater joy than seeing their shadow, Christ brings the true substance of salvation.

### The High Priest We Have
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-high-priest-we-have
Passage: Hebrews 8:1-2
Points:
- Christ’s superior priesthood is an established, living reality rather than a theoretical idea.
- Sitting at God's right hand signifies His divine honor, sovereign authority, and triumph over all enemies.
- Jesus exercises His priestly ministry in the true heavenly tabernacle rather than a temporary earthly copy.
- Believers can run directly to Christ for lasting peace, wisdom, and aid in all spiritual distresses.
